steps.note: Start creating the eRFX draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required tenant configuration for vendor addition during creation.
Apply the required stage configuration.
Give the draft a title so it can be identified and saved.
Configure the draft with an RFQ stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template.
Apply a pricing template so line items can be added.
Create the single line item needed for the Items 1 control.
Complete the pricing sheet for the draft line item.
Commit a valid draft schedule.
Save the configured eRFX as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to reach the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the saved draft's line-item window.
Verify that the Manage Line Items window opened.
Verify that the window contains the Quantity control.
Verify that the expected variant control is present.
Verify that Cancel is available in the window.
Verify that Save is available in the window.
